meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 在 Claude Code 里输入 /caveman-stats 时,它会原样打印当前会话记录的输出与缓存读取 token 用量、响应数和模式归属,放进代码块,不自行重算。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-stats 时接管;在 Gemini CLI 中会引导你用 /stats model 或 /stats session,其他宿主改用本机自带的用量报告。

say.text: 打印当前会话的 token 用量报告
say.note: 以代码块原样输出,不做重算
按每个会话最新输出数汇总
只报观察到的用量,节省量未知

howto.what_en: In Claude Code, running /caveman-stats prints the session's recorded output and cache-read token usage, response counts, and mode attribution verbatim in a fenced code block, without recomputing the numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-stats. In Gemini CLI you are directed to /stats model or /stats session; other hosts use a native usage report if available, otherwise session usage is called unavailable.

say_en.text: Show the recorded token usage for this session
say_en.note: Prints the report verbatim in a code block
Aggregates the latest output count per session
Reports observed usage; savings stay unknown
